diagnosis.classification: valid directional mechanism with an artificially fixed pullback duration
diagnosis.reason: a trader observes a completed pullback state, not exactly one fixed fifteen-minute return; valid countertrend retracements in the same one-hour price-discovery state lasted between ten and thirty minutes

controlled_revision.after: completed pullback horizons of 10, 15, 20, 25 or 30 minutes; select the deepest valid countertrend pullback and require the immediately previous five-minute bar to remain countertrend or stalled before the first reacceleration bar

unchanged.stop: beyond selected pullback extreme plus 0.15 ATR
unchanged.target: prior one-hour external liquidity plus 0.50 selected-pullback extension

promotion_rule: If the revealed first week passes every criterion, freeze the candidate and prospectively select a fresh second BTC week. Otherwise discard without further pullback-duration tuning.
